Dear Asako and Mr. Koga,
Thank you, and I am also very much looking forward to meeting both of you in person!
Asako, thank you very much for the updated schedule. 4pm would be absolutely fine for the Japanese manner
lesson. And what a beautiful traditional room for the lessons! You are very kind and thoughtful to mention about
not seating on the tatami mat for too long, but I will try my best.
In regards to the phone call, I apologize, unfortunately I will not be able to speak tonight at 8-9pm NY time due
to an important event I have to be at...would it be possible to do a similar or later time on Saturday, which would
be Sunday morning for you, I could wait till 11 pm - 12am my time, so that it is not too early for you...please
kindly let me know if that might work?
Thank you very much and have a great weekend ahead!
Karyna
